Chapters.afc_ch1_intro: Shut up game, I'll kill you
BonusChapters.nullified/afc_ch1_escape_a: Scrapter 2: I Need A Back Rub
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody01: [b][Announcer][/b] I hate that you're participating in Test Course B.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody02: [b][Announcer][/b] Did I worry you that you may have accidentally loaded the main campeign?
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody03: [b][Announcer][/b] Anyways, that's besides the point. You're here for bonus content, so...
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody04: [b][Announcer][/b] Let me tell you a story of game developement.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody05: [b][Announcer][/b] In May of 2026, Donovan from DonnyWorks Game Studios began work on a project.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody06: [b][Announcer][/b] That project is known as Masonry Toolkit.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody07: [b][Announcer][/b] It's the groundwork laid for the game as you know it today.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody08: [b][Announcer][/b] The first map, FPSC_Test featured a simple box with lights for use with the test 'weapon'.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody09: [b][Announcer][/b] The second map, devtest2, featured the first instance of the cube you've seen in ATC.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody10: [b][Announcer][/b] I'm not kidding, every cube since is just a copy of that one.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody11: [b][Announcer][/b] Some time goes by- he adds pathfinding scripted sequences, the Spotter from OS95 Plus, portals...
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody12: [b][Announcer][/b] And after some time he starts going... "wouldn't it be nice if we had faith plates?"
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody13: [b][Announcer][/b] So he made faith plates. And then he made the first map.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody14: [b][Announcer][/b] This map would be known as... devtest_trust_flings.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody15: [b][Announcer][/b] Thank you for participating in Test Course B.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody16: [b][Announcer][/b] It just keeps going. He makes devtest_catapult_intro.
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody17: [b][Announcer][/b] And then he makes devtest_flingcourse_in... tro... am I boring you?
Announcer.Bonus.IntroParody18: [b][Announcer][/b] Be serious with me- am I boring you?
Announcer.Intro01: [b][Announcer][/b] I hate that you're participating in Test Course B.
Announcer.Intro02: [b][Announcer][/b] You have been assigned test subject ID #4-2-0
Announcer.Intro03: [b][Announcer][/b] This testing course may be very dangerous.
Announcer.Intro04: [b][Announcer][/b] This course contains the following hazards:
Announcer.Intro06: [b][Announcer][/b] Flying into a hole in space at quick speeds
Announcer.Intro08: [b][Announcer][/b] Having to use your brain to solve puzzles
Announcer.Intro12: [b][Announcer][/b] If you are not okay with any of this, screw you.
Announcer.Intro13: [b][Announcer][/b] To make sure your copy of [STUPIDITY] was installed correctly,
Announcer.Intro14: [b][Announcer][/b] we will be running a very complex physical and mental health exercise.
Announcer.Chamber1.01: [b][Announcer][/b] This test has been designed to verify we gave you a hard enough concussion.
Announcer.Chamber1.02: [b][Announcer][/b] Please go and place the cube onto the button.
Announcer.Chamber1.Complete: [b][Announcer][/b] Good. You have proven that you are more of a moron than Wheatley. Proceed to the teleporter.
Announcer.Chamber1.BoxTrap: [b][Announcer][/b] Congrats. Science has now verified that your dumbass is braindead.
Announcer.Chamber1.WallClip: [b][Announcer][/b] An attempt to leave the game's playable area has been detected. We have prevented this attempt to make sure you don't leave us an angry Steam review. Thank you and have fun!
Announcer.Chamber4.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Hold on. You're completeting these tests faster than our one underpaid intern can finish building them,
Announcer.Chamber4.02: [b][Announcer][/b] So just give me a few more moments while I put the last few finishing touches on this next piece of cobbled-together trash.
Announcer.OLD.Chamber5.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Test subject! I'm so sorry! Sorry that I don't gi-!
Announcer.OLD.Chamber5.02: [b][Announcer][/b] Apparently, the level designer can't come up with an idea for this chamber and they're just smacking things together at random!
Announcer.OLD.Chamber5.03: [b][Announcer][/b] Although, with the state it's in, I doubt that entry door will open any time soon. Luckily, that tube in front of you broke that wall clean open.
Announcer.Chapter1Demo: [b][Announcer][/b] Good job on completing the Chapter 1 playtest and [s]Chapter 2 demo[/s]. Last I checked, I didn't ask for your opinion.
Announcer.Chamber3.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Did you know that 98% of test subjects experience disorientation after emerging from stasis?
Announcer.Chamber3.02: [b][Announcer][/b] It doesn't seem you're in that other 2% though, as you successfully failed to catch the box a million times.
Announcer.Chamber2.Intro: [b][Announcer][/b] Welcome to the first [i]real[/i] test. Go die.
Announcer.Chamber1.GetPortalGun.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Ve- ve- very good! You are now in possession of the Aperture Science- I mean- [b]LEGALLY DISTINCT[/b] handheld portal device.
Announcer.Chamber1.GetPortalGun.02: [b][Announcer][/b] With it, you can create more distancing in your relationship! In layman's terms, it lets you make portals.
Announcer.Chamber1.GetPortalGun.03: [b][Announcer][/b] However, it seems this part of the testing course isn't in the best shape. Good luck finding the panel you need to get outta here.
Announcer.Chamber1.Part2Intro: [b][Announcer][/b] This next test was designed for users that only had the single-tunnel device. However, you have the dual-tunnel device. Go ahead and weep on the ground, it sounds funny.
Announcer.Chamber1.ButtonFailure.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Whoa! Test subject- Man, that must suck for you!
Announcer.Chamber1.ButtonFailure.02: [b][Announcer][/b] Now, I don't plan on helpin you at all,
Announcer.Chamber1.ButtonFailure.03: [b][Announcer][/b] Good luck finding your own solution to this puzzle!
Announcer.Chamber1.CompleteDialogInterru: [b][Announcer][/b] Test subject, that's incredibly rude! I was in the middle of my ending line!
Announcer.Chamber1.Part2CompleteDialog: [b][Announcer][/b] C'mon, you had to find your way around, test subject?! I was betting a lot that you couldn't do it.
